product.name: Version Story Redlining and Version Control Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for comparing, redlining, and managing versions of legal documents, supporting Word and PDF formats with merge and export capabilities.

identifier.value: Version Story Document Version Organization and History Visualization

product.name: Version Story Document Version Organization and History Visualization
product.description: A feature that organizes and visually displays the full history and versions of legal documents to provide clarity and easy navigation through drafts and edits.

identifier.value: Version Story Merge and Conflict Resolution

product.name: Version Story Merge and Conflict Resolution
product.description: A tool to consolidate multiple document drafts into a single version by automatically detecting and resolving conflicting edits from different contributors.

identifier.value: Version Story Integrations with Legal and Office Systems

product.name: Version Story Integrations with Legal and Office Systems
product.description: Integrations with document management and office tools such as iManage, NetDocuments, SharePoint, Word, and Outlook to streamline legal document workflows.
